column1: # ADR-068 M2: every difference between the frontends' types, encodings and blueprints, with its class (D13). The corpus
# tools fail on a difference that is not here, and on an entry they no longer find.

column3: T33, #284: diverge-t33-top-level-user-value-on-local: the reference drops the top-level user record Value for the ledger's; javac registers the user's. Semantic fix, deferred to M3 to observe
T33, #284: diverge-t33-packageless-rational: the reference reads the user record in the ledger Rational's layout; javac registers the user's
T33, #286: diverge-t33-packageless-pubkeyhash-record: the reference makes a user record named PubKeyHash the ledger's bytes; javac registers the user's
T33, #286: the same case: the reference's Data of the user record is the bytes the ledger hash would be; javac's registry gives Constr 0 [bytes], which is what the JVM's record is

D8: a library unit the root does not reference declares a second Token. The reference registers it, so the blueprint names com.myapp.Token by its stable id; javac does not read the unit, so it stays Token
